nativeRelocationEvidence: The native-input whole file writes ABI5_NATIVE_BUILD_PROOF_RECORD as JSON. It records two distinct clean roots; protected and execution input inventories before/after; snapshot-style regular input modes 0644; actual child argv/exit/duration; relocated compiler/linker/resource/SDK/include roots; output path/bytes/SHA256 for each build; source/protected/host conservation; no ambient fallback negatives. Exact arrays/paths remain test-owned implementation. Operator retains and checks record, output equality and conserved hashes. When the Operator record path is selected, leave the two run directories and exact output files in that external proof scratch until the Operator has read them; ordinary unrecorded test runs may clean up. The execution input digest excludes compiler outputs and includes the derived executable input view only.
coldLoadEvidence: Both missing and incompatible addon cases use disposable candidate copies in fresh Node processes; cold loading, unaffected public import and existing uncertainty refusal, with no target effects. Never patch the cached native exports as a substitute.
generatedFinalInventories: No refresh until final composed source; this is preparation evidence only.

nativeRelocationRecordSchema.runs: exactly two rows: root, protectedRoot, executionRoot, compiler, argv[], exitCode=0, output={path,bytes,sha256}, protectedBeforeDigest=protectedAfterDigest, executionBeforeDigest=executionAfterDigest, hostBeforeDigest=hostAfterDigest, snapshotInputMode=420. All digests lowercase bare SHA256. Paths absolute under external proof scratch; executionRoot under each run root/build. Each output must equal the ordinary build native output.
